target.title: fix(feishu): add chunk-idle timeout to inbound media download
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Feishu inbound media downloads that stall after the Lark SDK returns a stream body (headers/start ok, then no further chunks) would block `saveMessageResourceFeishu` forever via `saveMediaStream`'s unbounded `for await`, so inbound dispatch never produces an agent reply for that attachment.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Route every Feishu inbound `saveMediaStream` path through `saveMediaStreamWithIdleTimeout` (production floor 30s), matching Telegram's download idle floor and the WhatsApp/LINE channel pattern.
- Idle helper lives in `extensions/feishu/src/media-chunk-idle.ts` so the oversized legacy `media.ts` does not grow past the LOC ratchet.
- On timeout, reject with `FeishuInboundMediaTimeoutError`, call `iterator.return()`, and silence the losing `next()`.
- Only `saveMediaStreamWithIdleTimeout` is exported (knip); timeout class/helper stay module-private.
- Does **not** change core `saveMediaStream` / `src/media/store.ts`.
- Does **not** touch Feishu docx URL reads (`#104663`).

No new config/env surface.

## User Impact

**Before:** A stalled Feishu message-resource body could hang inbound handling for that attachment indefinitely.

**After:** Idle streams fail closed after 30s with a clear timeout error so the Feishu monitor loop can continue.

## Evidence

Head: `6b965bbf7b143876d09fe7487c541076d0f90644`

Executable negative control + fix proof:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/feishu/src/media-chunk-idle.test.ts -- --run --reporter=verbose
```

```text
stdout | extensions/feishu/src/media-chunk-idle.test.ts > saveMediaStreamWithIdleTimeout > negative control: never-yielding stream without idle wrap stays pending
[feishu media idle negative control] outcome=still-pending wait_ms=150 without_idle_wrap=true
[feishu media idle proof] timed_out=true elapsed_ms=51 chunkTimeoutMs=50 production_ms=30000
 ✓ |extension-feishu| extensions/feishu/src/media-chunk-idle.test.ts > saveMediaStreamWithIdleTimeout > negative control: never-yielding stream without idle wrap stays pending 156ms
[feishu media idle proof] production_default_ms=30000 timed_out=true
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  5 passed (5)
```

- **Negative control (executable):** same never-yielding AsyncIterable consumed with bare `for await` (no idle wrap) stays `still-pending` after 150ms.
- **After fix:** `saveMediaStreamWithIdleTimeout` with 50ms floor rejects promptly; production default advances fake timers to 30s; `iterator.return()` called once on timeout.
- Touched: `extensions/feishu/src/media-chunk-idle.ts` + `media.ts` call sites (LOC-neutral helper extract). Sibling WhatsApp/LINE idle floors unchanged (different owners).

AI-assisted.
